    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:

          type: string
          format: uri

          title: Title

          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

## What I changed

The response DTOs are generated from `openapi.yml` and populated by MapStruct from `@Transient` getters on the `Owner` domain model — the same pattern used by `displayName`, `membershipNumber`, etc. I followed it and kept each piece of logic in its own small unit:

1. **`model/CountryDialingCode.java`** (new) — extracted the country-code knowledge (code → national-digit-length: `61`→9, `1`→10) that was previously *private* inside `TelephoneNormalizer` into one shared table with `matching(...)` and `nationalLength(...)`. This is now the single source of truth for country codes.
